scores.visual_critic_note: Dark theme with consistent muted-blue accent and structured grid layout shows intentional design, but the color-usage scatter panel renders as an illegible mass of tiny dots and 9px network labels disappear at actual render size.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Zero baseline on bar chart, scaleSqrt for all circle encodings, data-driven domains via d3.extent/d3.max throughout, and fixed y-scale under filtering prevents jumping axes — no significant honesty violations.
scores.stress_test_note: Dirty-flag + RAF pattern correctly protects DOM mutations, no infinite loops, and pointer events avoid dual-trigger; deductions for unthrottled O(n) BitFilter recomputation inside brush mousemove, stale scale closure on resize, and absent touch-scroll filter on brushes.
scores.cognitive_load_note: 4 linked views stay within working memory limits, the 60-node network shows visible clusters rather than a hairball, and the color scatter's density is intentional pattern-reading — main unassessable risk is the force layout reheating on every filter change, which could create swarming animation noise under interaction.
flags: Update Storm (partial) — BitFilter.set() O(n) recomputation fires unthrottled on every brush mousemove despite RAF-coalesced DOM flushes
Stale Scale Closure — x/y scales captured at init with no resize handler; window resize silently breaks brush coordinate inversion
Mouse-Touch Fight — no .filter() guard on d3.brush or pointer handlers to prevent mobile scroll/brush conflict
